prompt: Which of these is the best success criterion for a sentiment classifier?

options.text: The model should classify sentiment well.
Achieve an F1 score of at least 0.85 on a held-out test set of 10,000 diverse posts, a 5% improvement over the current baseline.
The model should beat all competitors.

explanation: Good criteria are specific, measurable, achievable and relevant. The F1 threshold on a held-out set with a stated baseline is quantitative and testable, unlike vague goals such as "well".

sources.title: Define success criteria and build evaluations (Claude Docs)
